name: Spy
ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
designRole: Grimoire knowledge supports evil planning; optional good registration supports false confirmation.
explanation: Grimoire knowledge supports evil planning; optional good registration supports false confirmation.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
nightInstructions.otherNights: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Spy has no Spy ability & a Spy is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Spy may publicly guess a living player as the Spy. If correct, the Demon must choose the Spy tonight.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
When the Spy sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
If the Storyteller would gain the Spy ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
The Spy registers as evil to the Ogre.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.
